Submission of online applications begins on November 5, 2026, and December 5, 2026 is the last date to apply. Check the notification pdf, application process, crucial dates, and other details here.
OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026: The Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) has released an indicative notice regarding the recruitment of District Cadre Group-C posts on its official website. A total of 238 Ophthalmic Officer posts are to be filled through the much-awaited recruitment drive across the state. Candidates with the requisite educational qualifications can apply for these positions at 29 district establishments under the Health & Family Welfare Department of the Government of Odisha.
The online application process will commence from November 05, 2026, and interested and eligible candidates can apply till December 05, 2026 at www.osssc.gov.in.
OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification
Presently, the OSSSC has released the indicative notification regarding the recruitment to the post of Ophthalmic Officer under the Health & Family Welfare Department of the Government of Odisha.
